title: Painting with the Split Brush Technique
content: There's snow on the ground, but it's about 50 degrees Fahrenheit (10C), so I can bring the casein paint outdoors.I paint this field study with a limited palette of casein. I use a split brush technique to suggest the texture of dry weeds. (Link to YouTube)Split brush painting is a way to hint at a lot of detail without meticulously painting every twig.----Basic set of caseins:Jack Richeson Casein (6 Pack)
